item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.1
item.description: - Changed your mind? Right after a matched paste, ⌃⌘V swaps it for the original, untouched. - The menu bar icon blinks once when a paste is matched. - AI citations are left out: ChatGPT's source chips ("nytimes.com +1"), "【4†source】" marks and footnote numbers. - Links lose their tracking (utm_… and the like), and Google, Outlook, Facebook, LinkedIn and Slack redirect links paste as the real address. - Tables: headers on the left, text at the top of each cell, and space between columns. - New in Settings: Keep headings big, to keep headings as real headings, and Clean up AI punctuation, for plain dashes, quotes and dots.
